story_unit: Luo observes the lived reality of a student-affairs role before applying
he applies anyway and discovers the gap between process competence and direct student-work experience
a second failed student-affairs attempt forces a narrower self-assessment rather than a moral lesson
he searches for research-support work that retains university context, process responsibility and research literacy
he receives a modest offer and begins the new job
the imagined fit is immediately tested by ordinary institutional work
active_opening_unit.reader_memory_goal: By the end of the opening unit the reader should know Luo Cheng through scenes, repeated choices, embarrassment, partial competence and consequences, not through a profile paragraph.

opening_anchor_rule: The first memorable protagonist must remain focal long enough for the reader's initial investment to pay off. Do not introduce a core actor in the opening merely to remove them for many chapters. Establish one person, one live problem, and real consequences first; ensemble expansion happens later through the active story.
relay_rule: Water-Margin-like relay remains valid after the anchor is established. Event relay does not require protagonist rotation, and it never overrides the need for the current live problem to finish or deepen.
arc_rendering_rule: Campbell structures a character longitudinally after entry. It never chooses who appears next. Foreground prose stays partial, visual, fallible and under-explained.
nonnegotiable_rules: No adaptation hypothesis becomes ledger history.
Do not broaden the cast before the opening anchor is memorable through action and consequence.
Do not introduce a core actor because the roster says it is their turn.
The opening may spend several chapters with one protagonist.
A new major character enters only when the current story naturally reaches them and the reader has room to remember them.
Do not force a handoff every chapter.
Early chapters should normally add no more than one or two memorable names at a time.
Use role labels for nonrecurring guests until a name matters.
Background leaks through action, dialogue, objects, institutions, money, space and other people's reactions rather than profile paragraphs.
High education does not imply universal negotiation, leadership, emotional or social skill.
Every strong capability must have a formation source, shadow cost and high-pressure failure mode.
A virtue must be allowed to create costs; a flaw must be allowed to protect something real.
Power changes how personality is expressed; separate trait from position effect.
Campbell stages are backend structure only and never chapter labels, thesis dialogue or explicit self-diagnosis.
Character transformation changes probabilities, thresholds and recovery patterns; it does not permanently remove old flaws.
Every core actor retains at least one materially unresolved ambiguity at the 2035 horizon.
Do not force romance, illness, family disaster, betrayal, crime or redemption to manufacture a hook.
Do not imitate Water Margin through archaic diction or chapter-title pastiche; borrow its event-driven introduction and relay mechanics only.
Do not use AI-summary endings, thesis dialogue, forced symbolism or universal self-awareness.
2035 is an observation endpoint, not a life verdict.
opening_audit_questions: Is the reader still following the same live problem rather than being asked to meet a new protagonist?
What has Luo done that makes him memorable without a biography paragraph?
Did the latest consequence arise from his earlier choice?
Are repeated interviews genuinely different scenes rather than duplicate Q&A structures?
Has the story moved from imagined work to lived work?
Does the current problem deserve another Luo chapter before any ensemble expansion?
If a new major character appears next, what concrete event requires them?

required_before_broad_ensemble_expansion: revise Chapters1-3 by subtraction where dialogue is too neat or interview structure too repetitive
continue Luo Cheng at work into at least one scene with genuine human incentive conflict, authority asymmetry, embarrassment or misunderstanding rather than document mechanics alone
do not introduce Song Nan, Zhou Ye, Gao Yuan, Tang Yu or He Xin merely to signal ensemble breadth
allow Sun Jie and workplace guests to recur because they belong to Luo's active story
only after Luo's opening unit is memorable and his lived work has begun may a new core protagonist enter through a concrete event
next_stage_gate.drafting_rule: Stay with Luo Cheng until the opening anchor review passes. Do not return to the old chapter map or fast relay route.
